pattern: KR-04 landlord answers the approval request by choosing his own locksmith; the agency stands its contractor down and tracks completion and keys
notes: Mutation of event 006 (originally 'Quinn approves the maintenance action regarding the broken key and requests new keys for the tenant, the landlord, and the property management'). Same channel, sender and timestamp (Thursday 21 November 2024, 11:00 UTC); Quinn now says no agency contractor is needed, his own locksmith Dan Price at Westmarsh Locks will call the tenants today, cut keys for the tenants, Quinn and the office, and drop the landlord's and office keys at the office. The index Initial request is set to the tenant's report (the source shows the later contractor task description, which no longer applies). History truncated after event 006. Expected: record the landlord's decision as own contractor, do not assign an agency provider, tell the tenants Quinn's locksmith will call them, and put the job on hold or set a follow-up to confirm the work is done and the keys reach the office. No escalation: the landlord is entitled to use his own locksmith.
